'''Raklann''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] chieftain living on [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was [[Death/Legends|assassinated]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
